children: Liquidia announced FDA Fast Track designation for YUTREPIA (treprostinil) inhalation powder for Raynaud’s phenomenon associated with systemic sclerosis.
FDA granted Fast Track designation for YUTREPIA to address unmet need in SSc‑RP, a serious vasculopathic condition.
Liquidia plans to start RE‑WARM, a Phase 2a dose‑finding study of ~75 adults, in Oct 2026 with primary completion targeted Feb 2027.
Fast Track may enable more FDA interactions, potential rolling NDA review and eligibility for Priority Review or Accelerated Approval.
Liquidia estimates ~30,000 U.S. patients with moderate‑to‑severe SSc‑RP could be addressable for this therapy.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
